source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Christ's service to the circumcised and covenantal confirmation.
key_decisions.before: For I tell you that Christ became a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the ancestors,
key_decisions.after: For I say that Christ became a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God's truth, in order to confirm the promises given to the patriarchs,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For I say that Christ has become a servant of the circumcision on behalf of the truth of God, to confirm the promises to the fathers,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the sustained priestly metaphor and Gentiles as offering.
key_decisions.before: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving the gospel of God in a priestly way, so that the offering of the Gentiles may be acceptable, made holy by the Holy Spirit.
key_decisions.after: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, performing the priestly service of God's good news, so that the Gentiles might become an acceptable offering, made holy by the Holy Spirit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the gospel of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles may become acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves signs, wonders, Spirit, exact geography, and completed proclamation claim.
key_decisions.before: by the power of signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God, so that from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum I have fully proclaimed the good news of Christ.
key_decisions.after: by the power of signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit. Thus, from Jerusalem and all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the good news of Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Spirit, so that from Jerusalem and all the way around to Illyricum I have fulfilled the gospel of Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Spain, mutual visit, practical support, and partial satisfaction.
key_decisions.before: I hope to see you when I travel to Spain and to be sent on my way there by you, after first enjoying your company for a while.
key_decisions.after: I hope to see you when I travel to Spain and to be sent on my way there by you, after I have first enjoyed your company for a while.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: whenever I go to Spain—for I hope to see you as I pass through and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while—

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves delight and obligation, Gentile/Jewish reciprocity, and spiritual/material contrast.
key_decisions.before: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they also owe service to them in material things.
key_decisions.after: They were pleased to do so, and indeed they are indebted to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they also owe it to them to serve them with material blessings.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For they were pleased to do it, and they are indebted to them; for if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual things, they are obligated also to minister to them in material things.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders the sealing idiom as secure delivery while keeping fruit and route.
key_decisions.before: Therefore, when I have completed this and safely delivered this fruit to them, I will leave for Spain by way of you.
key_decisions.after: Therefore, after I have completed this task and securely delivered this fruit to them, I will leave for Spain by way of you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore, when I have completed this and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go by way of you to Spain.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned Christ reading and preserves fullness.
key_decisions.before: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of Christ’s blessing.
key_decisions.after: And I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of Christ's blessing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the double appeal and athletic struggle-together metaphor.
key_decisions.before: I urge you, brothers and sisters, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the Spirit’s love, to struggle together with me in prayers to God for me,
key_decisions.after: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit, to struggle together with me in prayers to God on my behalf,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now I urge you, brothers, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in prayers to God for me,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the real danger, Judean location, and uncertainty about the gift's reception.
key_decisions.before: that I may be rescued from the disobedient in Judea and that my service for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the holy ones,
key_decisions.after: that I may be rescued from those in Judea who are disobedient, and that my service for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the holy ones,
